flipbook.alpha: straight (not premultiplied); draw with standard alpha blending, no depth write

ventAnchor.note: frame-relative, v measured from the bottom; put this point on the crater

flipbook.worldSize: the window is 0.40 x 0.40 panorama units; on a 2048x1024 panorama that is ~819 px wide, so scale the quad to the backdrop
flipbook.source: port of RPGWorldBuilder/PaintedBackground.shader smoke pass (four puffs, age = frac(t*0.045 + j*0.25 + 0.04)) at smokeSpeed = 1
flipbook.atlas: volcano_smoke_atlas.png is the generator's original RGBA atlas (top half cloud band, bottom half single puff) for engines that re-implement the shader

smoke.howToUse: Use a world-space quad with built-in-compatible alpha blending (SrcAlpha/OneMinusSrcAlpha, ZWrite Off). Play 16 frames in a 4x4 sheet at 2.88fps, row-major top-left; i=floor(t*2.88)%16; UV scale=(0.25,0.25), offset=(i%4/4,1-(floor(i/4)+1)/4). Put frame-relative anchor (0.5,0.1375) on the crater. The sequence may repeat; use the original atlas plus shader maths for continuous puff animation.
smoke.atlas: volcano_smoke_atlas.png: 1024x1024 RGBA, cloud strip top half, smoke puff bottom half
smoke.continuousShaderMaths: For j=3..0: age=frac(t*0.045*smokeSpeed+j*0.25+0.04), centre=(0.126-0.065*age+0.006*sin(age*7+t*0.18*smokeSpeed),0.515+0.22*age), size=(0.055+0.18*age,0.065+0.13*age), q=(uv-centre)/size+0.5; sample original atlas bottom half at (0.008+q.x*0.984,0.008+q.y*0.484); opacity=alpha*smoothstep(0,0.04,age)*(1-smoothstep(0.78,1,age))*0.82. Cloud U scroll=frac(uv.x-t*0.0018*cloudSpeed). No URP shader is supplied.

deviations: control.py API v1 supports only village/chapter/dungeon, not modular_kit. The required five API actions were executed unchanged in order using a private natural-volcano config. The generated whole scene supplies style textures only and is NOT shipped as the game map. The existing work-order kit_builder.py produced the modular parts in the new run directory; generator implementation was not modified.

The scene API surface atlas is capped at 1024px. The standalone kit builder repacks and bakes the requested shared 2048px albedo and 1024px emissive mask; only those kit textures are used by the mesh parts.

Approximate footprint deviations retained from the established 001 builder: inner corners are about 3.2 x 3.2m including player-side scree rather than approximately 2 x 2m; walls about 4.3m wide allow overlap at 4m spacing; gate frames about 4.3-4.5m wide; cave entrance approximately 13 x 9 x 7.8m rather than approximately 12 x 6 x 8m. Exact re-imported XYZ bounds are in kit.json and inspect.json.

Art uses procedural low-poly rock geometry and the generator hand-painted volcanic tiles, regraded toward the game ground, with AO and top-left key light baked into albedo; it is not an individually sculpted/painted asset library.

The additional gate files satisfy separate frame/door loading; the original combined gate files remain as compatibility resources, so their triangle instances are duplicated on disk, not additional required runtime geometry.
No new import into the SpellDuel Unity project or phone benchmark was performed. Independent Blender FBX re-import checks are current; mobile FPS is not claimed.
